scope: independent read-only source review; no browser or account operations

resolvedFindings.issue: Mobile media padding shorthands overrode the safe-area bottom inset
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both 760px and 340px media rules now retain max(padding,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); viewport-fit=cover stays supported

resolvedFindings.issue: Clicking the currently rendered level during an in-flight different-level request previously returned before cancelling that request
resolvedFindings.resolution: The same-level fast return is now limited to state.screen !== 'loading'; during loading the existing select change starts choosePair, increments its generation and aborts the previous request

reviewed: Level choices are real page buttons within native modal dialog; hidden legacy select is excluded from accessibility tree
Selected level is labelled by pressed state and visible tick; colour is not the sole selection cue
Close/Escape uses native dialog lifecycle and preserves expanded state; level and navigation dialogs close one another
Arrow/Home/End navigation uses the computed responsive grid column count
Popup bounds use visualViewport offsets and dimensions with resize/scroll listeners
Non-scrolling dialog header is separate from a min-height-zero, touch-scrollable body
Legacy L1 page has no level dialog; all new level event hooks and positioning calls are null-safe
Responsive auto-fit grid permits a single column in narrow/pinched visual viewports without shrinking text
Level change reuses the existing change event, choosePair, immutable content validation and course-access learning view; no entitlement shortcut
No data, catalogue, price, server account code, rights module or course-access manifest changed
Same-level selection during an in-flight request follows the existing generation/abort path; no new access or data path is introduced
limits: Source review only; browser, physical-device and native screen-reader validation are not claimed

advisories.detail: Level badges have fixed dimensions; extreme text-only sizing may make L10 text exceed its coloured circle. The button label and level title remain present; no separate badge-sizing feature is introduced in this fix.
